description: This PHP script manages test plan editing within the TestLink open source test management tool. It handles creating, updating, deleting, and displaying test plans, including file attachments, custom fields, and user permissions.

classes.name: testplan
classes.description: Class managing test plan data and operations.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine wrapper used for rendering views.

classes.name: tlUser
classes.description: User class with role and permission management.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes request arguments into an object.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if a user has rights to create or manage test plans in a project.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up the GUI object with test plan and project data, permissions, and URLs.

methods.name: getItemData
methods.description: Retrieves test plan data by ID and updates GUI and output objects.
